questions.category: A1 — Use Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) and Safety Equipment
questions.question: Why should a face shield be used with safety glasses during grinding?
options: To protect the face from sparks and flying particles
To make the grinder cut faster
questions.explanation:
Grinding can throw sparks and particles toward the face.
Safety glasses protect the eyes, while a face shield adds face protection.
Both may be required for this task.

questions.question: Why should oil or water spills be cleaned promptly?
options: They make metal easier to bend
questions.explanation:
Spills make walking surfaces slippery.
Cleaning them reduces falls and injuries.
A clean work area is safer and more efficient.

questions.category: A3 — Perform Lock-Out and Tag-Out Procedures
questions.question: Why should stored energy be released before servicing equipment?
options: Stored energy can move machine parts unexpectedly
It makes the machine easier to start
questions.explanation:
Machines can store energy in springs, air pressure, hydraulics, or electrical systems.
That energy can release suddenly during service.
Lock-out includes controlling stored energy.

questions.question: Why should chemical containers be labelled?
options: To identify the product and its hazards
To make containers look neat only
questions.explanation:
Labels help workers identify hazardous products.
They provide important safety information.
Unlabelled containers can lead to unsafe use.

questions.category: B1 — Use Hand and Portable Power Tools
questions.question: Why should tin snips not be used as a pry tool?
options: Misuse can damage the snips and cause injury
questions.explanation:
Snips are cutting tools.
Using them for prying can bend blades or handles.
Damaged snips are unsafe and cut poorly.
